label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
Dear friends, neighbors, church family, and my dear ladies,

After 11 years on Bellaire Blvd, Lotus Glow Nails had a visitor we were NOT ready for. Around 2 a.m. on Sunday, November 8, a car came through our front window.

Thank God, nobody was inside, and the driver is okay. The police came, and her insurance will cover the damage. The front glass is gone, and one pedicure chair is smashed. The car stopped right at that chair, like she came in for a spa day. My daughter says she got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston. Please, ladies, appointments only. No more drive-thru!

The floor looks like a rainbow threw up. My husband says finally the shop is modern art. I do not think we can charge admission.

I am okay. I cried a little in the morning, but now I am okay. Glass and chairs can be replaced. I thank God nobody was inside.

Here is what you need to know:

**Lotus Glow Nails is closed for now.** Our contractor expects us to reopen **Monday, November 16**, but the city inspector must check the wall before we can open. That date is not final until we get approval. Please call or text me before coming.

**This week, Trang, Kim, and I are working at my cousin Hoa’s salon, Pearland Nail Bar.** To book your nails or check on an appointment, call or text my cell: **832-555-0147**. We will still take care of you!

**Your Lotus Glow Nails gift cards are still good. Nobody will lose their money.**

Thank you for all the calls, texts, prayers, and food. Mrs. Dung brought pho this morning, so please know I am being fed and loved very well.

Please pass this message around your group texts and emails. My phone has not stopped ringing, and I only have two hands—even when I am not doing nails!

Do not worry too much about me. We have a mess to clean up, but we are safe, and I am so grateful for all of you.

With love,  
Your friend at Lotus Glow Nails
